problem:
Describe the set $S={...,-21,-17,-13,-9,-5,...}$ using a constructive definition.

*Hint: Take ${a}_{1}=-5$ in the sequence that generates the elements of $S.$*

$$
4n-9
$$
worked_solution:
Notice that the elements of our set

$$
…,\,-21,\,-17,\,-13,\,-9,\,-5,\,…
$$

form a two-way infinite arithmetic sequence with common difference $d=4:$

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =4 \\  & =-17-(-21) \\  & =-13-(-17) \\  & =-9-(-13) \\  & =⋯\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, setting  ${a}_{1}=-5,$ the $n$th term ${a}_{n}$ of our sequence for $n\in Z$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{n} & ={a}_{1}+(n-1)\cdot d \\  & =-5+(n-1)\cdot 4 \\  & =-5+4n-4 \\  & =4n-9.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we can define our set using a constructive definition as follows:

$$
S={4n-9\,:\,n\in Z}
$$
